B1.title: Retail apartment detector (cost first)
assumptions: Q1 default: Dark grey or textured dark colour
Q2 default: Survive repeated drops from desk height (~0.75 m) onto hard floor
Q3 default: No IP rating required (indoor use)

B2.title: Construction-site handheld (rugged)
assumptions: Q1 default: Assume standard UV stabilised ABS or PC-ABS suitable for prolonged outdoor use, with high-visibility colour that resists fading for at least 3 years.
Q2 default: Use safety orange or yellow as primary colour with dark contrasting overmould or inserts for grip areas.
Q3 default: Assume 1.5 m drop onto concrete on all faces and corners, 6 drops total, per typical rugged device standards.
Q4 default: Yes, design with pronounced ribs or overmoulded TPE grips on sides and back for secure handling with gloves.

B3.title: Living-room sideboard object (premium)
assumptions: Q1 default: Assume a typical living room viewing distance of 2.5-3 meters, requiring a display size of at least 2.5-3 inches diagonal.
Q2 default: Assume moderate handling and occasional cleaning; choose a soft-touch coating with good abrasion resistance.
Q3 default: Assume neutral colors (e.g., warm grey, off-white) and a fine matte texture that blends with modern furniture.

B4.title: Circular edition (sustainable)
assumptions: Q1 default: No specific IP rating required; indoor use only.
Q2 default: Standard consumer electronics drop height of 1 meter onto concrete.
Q3 default: Natural or lightly tinted rABS with visible speckles; color to be determined with brand.
Q4 default: CNY 18 per unit as per overall BOM ceiling.

B5.title: Flagship that wants everything (intentionally conflicting)
assumptions: Relaxed cost_ceiling_cny: 9 -> 18 (cheapest feasible housing costs CNY 12.59 > target CNY 9)
Relaxed max_height_mm: 18 -> 26 (PCB+battery stack needs >= 25.0 mm overall height at 1.5 mm walls)
Relaxed max_mass_g: 120 -> 180 (lightest feasible product weighs 120.5 g > 120 g)
Q1 default: Internals fit within 18 mm thickness with minimal clearance; if not, thickness must increase.
Q2 default: Finish on all external surfaces.
Q3 default: No specific drop requirement; standard handling only.
Q4 default: Matte black or dark gray, smooth soft-touch.

B6.title: Open-plan office desk unit (balanced control)
assumptions: Q1 default: No specific IP rating required (indoor use only).
Q2 default: No specific drop height requirement; standard office handling assumed.
Q3 default: Desk-standing design.

intent.summary: Retail-channel air quality detector for rental apartments. Lowest possible unit cost is the top priority: target CNY 12 per housing at 10k units/year. Plain but tidy look in a colour that hides scuffs and fingerprints. It must survive knocks on a desk. Two-part shell, no decoration beyond a printed logo, budget tooling.

conflicts.description: Target housing cost of CNY 12 may be difficult to achieve with ABS/PC-ABS/rABS at 10k units/year, especially with tooling amortization and a two-part shell.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Consider simplifying design, reducing wall thickness, using lower-cost material (e.g., standard ABS), or negotiating tooling cost; verify feasibility with cost estimation.

intent.summary: Sustainable edition for an eco-conscious brand. Use only recycled ABS for every plastic part, no paint or coatings, a mono-material housing and screw-free disassembly so it can be repaired and recycled. Honest, warm, slightly speckled look; carbon footprint matters more than gloss.
must_haves: Use only recycled ABS for every plastic part

conflicts.description: Screw-free disassembly may conflict with the need for a secure, durable enclosure that can withstand typical handling and potential drops, especially without additional fasteners or coatings.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Use snap-fit or living hinge designs that allow tool-free opening while maintaining adequate retention force; validate with drop and vibration testing.

conflicts.description: Recycled ABS (rABS) may have lower impact strength and surface quality compared to virgin ABS, potentially affecting the ability to meet durability and aesthetic requirements without coatings.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Select high-quality rABS with consistent properties; adjust wall thickness and rib design to compensate for reduced mechanical properties; use textured finish to mask surface imperfections.

intent.summary: Flagship portable air-quality detector housing with premium soft-touch painted finish, IP67 waterproof, ultra-slim 18 mm profile, 100% recycled plastic, under 120 g, and housing cost ≤ CNY 9, launching in six weeks.

conflicts.description: IP67 waterproofing typically requires seals, gaskets, and thicker walls, conflicting with an 18 mm ultra-slim profile and low mass.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Relax thickness to at least 22-25 mm or reduce waterproof rating to IP54.

conflicts.description: Soft-touch painted finish on 100% recycled ABS (rABS) may have adhesion and durability issues, especially with IP67 sealing and outdoor exposure.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Use a primer or select a paint system compatible with rABS; consider a matte overmold instead of paint.

conflicts.description: Housing cost ≤ CNY 9 with premium soft-touch paint, IP67 sealing, and 100% recycled material is likely infeasible at 10k units/year.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Increase budget to at least CNY 15-18 or reduce finish/waterproofing requirements.

conflicts.description: Launch in six weeks may be insufficient for tooling, painting process validation, and IP67 certification.
conflicts.proposed_resolution: Extend timeline to 10-12 weeks or use an existing platform with minor modifications.
